figurative_meaning_en: To pay attention; to maintain closeness
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুটিকে একটু ছোঁ দিয়ে যাও, অনেকদিন কথা হয়নি।
সে তার পরিবারকে ছোঁ দেয় না, সবসময় ব্যস্ত থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: Give your friend a touch; it's been a while since you talked.
He doesn't touch his family much; he's always busy.
note: This idiom reflects everyday relational dynamics in Bengali culture.
